verdict.rationale: Kong has an official first-party MCP server: a dedicated docs page titled 'Kong Konnect MCP Server', which a probe confirmed, so an agent can connect to the Konnect platform through MCP. The evidence is thin, though. Only the page title and the probe's existence check are available, with nothing on what the server exposes or how to set it up. Kong's MCP autogeneration and MCP gateway features cover customer APIs and MCP traffic, so they don't add to this story. Missing for 10: documented tool/resource coverage, client setup and auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
